arx_round8.vo.description: one ARX round: 8-bit add, rotate by 3, XOR, register
arx_round8.vo.role: positive control for the ARX pass

butterfly4.vo.description: 4-bit butterfly: a+b and a-b over the same operands
butterfly4.vo.role: positive control for butterfly detection, negative for the modulus

counter8.vo.description: 8-bit accumulator: adders without rotation or XOR layers
counter8.vo.role: negative control for the ARX pass -- an adder alone is not ARX

coupled_nlfsr.vo.description: two chains of 8 and 10 stages, each closed through the other
coupled_nlfsr.vo.role: positive control for coupled (Trivium/Grain-style) registers: neither chain has a feedback polynomial of its own

lfsr16_fibonacci.vo.description: 16-stage Fibonacci LFSR, x^16 + x^15 + x^13 + x^4 + 1
lfsr16_fibonacci.vo.role: positive control for the LFSR pass

lfsr16_galois.vo.description: 16-stage Galois LFSR with three injection points

lfsr16_loadable.vo.description: the same LFSR behind a parallel `load ? seed : shift`
lfsr16_loadable.vo.role: positive control for the operating-mode search: every shift link is a multiplexer until `load` is held at 0

nlfsr16.vo.description: 16-stage NLFSR: the same taps with an AND term in the feedback
nlfsr16.vo.role: negative control for *linear* feedback: no polynomial exists

ntt_stage13.vo.description: a butterfly with a conditional subtract of q = 3329
ntt_stage13.vo.role: positive control for the NTT pass and the PQC-style verdict

present_sbox_layer.vo.description: two PRESENT S-boxes between register banks
present_sbox_layer.vo.role: positive control for the S-box pass

rotate16.vo.description: two 16-bit register banks joined by a rotation of 5
rotate16.vo.role: positive control for the permutation pass, negative for ARX

shift16_plain.vo.description: 16-stage shift register with no feedback at all
shift16_plain.vo.role: negative control for the LFSR pass

unknown_sbox_layer.vo.description: the same shape with a 4-bit bijection that is in no library
unknown_sbox_layer.vo.role: negative control for S-box *matching*: extracted, never matched

provenance: Assembled from the tennm_lcell_comb and tennm_ff semantics in hal_agilex.primitives, which were validated against real Quartus exports in tools/hal_agilex/fixtures. Nothing here came out of Quartus, so nothing here is evidence about vendor primitive behaviour -- only about the hal_crypto recognizers.
